observations: The actual maintained password verifier precedes the captured-generation fence and native session rotation. Only actual password proof and database time transfer to the generated replacement.
An aged session cannot list native sessions before reauthentication. After rotation the old ID is denied and the new native cookie passes fresh-session middleware.
Failure after actual native replacement creation, cookie staging and old-session deletion rolls back both session writes and cookies; the independently committed attempt remains.
An official queued hook reads the committed replacement through an independent database connection only after the physical transaction commits.
limits: This does not activate or qualify native MFA/passkey ceremonies, operator admission or enterprise recovery.
The compiler excludes tests. This is a targeted integration pass, not a full workspace or V10 release qualification.
